## a3086dea6cff

A standard three-demonstration lesson can contain only one connector orientation. Reproducers: easy `seed=0` yields five horizontal pairs across samples 0..2; medium `seed=39` yields eight horizontal pairs; hard `seed=801` yields nine vertical pairs. A horizontal-only or vertical-only connector rival therefore fits the entire corresponding lesson. The exact pair coordinates and input hashes are recorded in `checks/audit_probes.json`. Schedule both orientations within each three-demo window or enforce a named orientation rival.
